title: Access: CheckAccess actions v1
description: DRAFT, proposed by project, waits for provisioning. Owner: project. Every action AccessService/CheckAccess accepts. write true: the action changes state, and Project refuses it on a deleted or suspended project (PROJECT_DELETED, PROJECT_SUSPENDED). write false: a get or list action, allowed there. admin_allowed: a caller may let an admin through without asking Project. Names are unique.
